page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-192-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1488.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. The instance is equipped with 32 local NVMe SSDs, providing high-speed local storage capabilities, while containing zero GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server configuration targets workloads requiring high memory capacity alongside massive parallel processing power. With 192 dedicated vCPUs, the instance offers high compute density. The inclusion of 32 local NVMe SSDs makes it highly suitable for I/O-intensive operations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of both memory and local storage on a single instance reduces the need for multi-node clustering, optimizing resource utilization for large-scale monolithic deployments.

The hardware profile of the c4n-highmem-192-lssd makes it suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory data processing, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and heavy ETL pipelines. The combination of high memory capacity and local NVMe SSD storage supports demanding transactional databases and real-time analytics workloads that require low-latency data access.
